name: Small Rooted Leaf-Block Carrier Census
definition: Apply the dimension-free degree-two isolated-support, adjacent-marker reversal, and anchored cross-carrier constraints to every rooted two-connected induced-cube block on at most six vertices.
properties: The candidate shapes are $C_4$, $C_6$, and the six-vertex domino. The constraints exclude both cycles and a domino rooted at a degree-three vertex; only a degree-two-rooted domino survives. The four first-witness searches visit $5,11,11,4$ nodes, and the surviving active masks are $(2,1,4),(3,6,5),(4,1,2),(5,6,3)$.
